fullText.simplified:
第十五章、新的楚王上位

    楚怀王决定去秦国了。他带着马车队，从引都出发去秦国。但是车队刚刚开进秦国的土地，引都就失去了楚怀王的消息。
    等了几天，引都收到了坏消息。原来楚怀王一到秦国，就被秦王抓走了。秦王把楚怀王关了起来，他要楚怀王把楚国的土地送给秦国。如果楚怀王不答应，秦王就不放他离开。
    国家的王被人抓了，楚怀王的小儿子子兰和引都的官员、贵族们害怕极了。他们马上去齐国，把在那儿做人质的楚国太子接了回来。太子回到楚国，马上做了楚国的新王。
    他们放弃了楚怀王！他们选了一个新王！
    新王上位，想的第一件事不是把楚怀王接回来，而是怎么让国内的官员、贵族们支持自己。新王让他们做大官，给他们更好的生活。子兰做了楚国最大的官，他和另外的大官们都不想楚怀王回来。他们害怕如果楚怀王回来了，楚怀王会杀了他们，因为是他们要楚怀王去秦国的。
    我既失望又着急，楚怀王被关在秦国，他们却只想着自己的好处。我骂新王，骂子兰，骂那些要楚怀王去秦国的官员、贵族们。但是没有用，他们都不听，新王也不想听。他们拿走了我的工作，让我又变成了一个无事可做的人。
    秦国的军队又打了过来。听说，被抓的楚怀王一直没有答应秦王的要求，秦王很生气，就让军队再来攻打楚国。大战一场接着一场。最大的那场战争里，五万楚军战死，十五座城被秦国抢走。
    在楚怀王被抓的第三年，楚国接到了最坏的消息——楚怀王在秦国病死了。
fullText.traditional:
第十五章、新的楚王上位

    楚懷王決定去秦國了。他帶著馬車隊，從引都出發去秦國。但是車隊剛剛開進秦國的土地，引都就失去了楚懷王的消息。
    等了幾天，引都收到了壞消息。原來楚懷王一到秦國，就被秦王抓走了。秦王把楚懷王關了起來，他要楚懷王把楚國的土地送給秦國。如果楚懷王不答應，秦王就不放他離開。
    國家的王被人抓了，楚懷王的小兒子子蘭和引都的官員、貴族們害怕極了。他們馬上去齊國，把在那兒做人質的楚國太子接了回來。太子回到楚國，馬上做了楚國的新王。
    他們放棄了楚懷王！他們選了一個新王！
    新王上位，想的第一件事不是把楚懷王接回來，而是怎麼讓國內的官員、貴族們支持自己。新王讓他們做大官，給他們更好的生活。子蘭做了楚國最大的官，他和另外的大官們都不想楚懷王回來。他們害怕如果楚懷王回來了，楚懷王會殺了他們，因為是他們要楚懷王去秦國的。
    我既失望又著急，楚懷王被關在秦國，他們卻只想著自己的好處。我罵新王，罵子蘭，罵那些要楚懷王去秦國的官員、貴族們。但是沒有用，他們都不聽，新王也不想聽。他們拿走了我的工作，讓我又變成了一個無事可做的人。
    秦國的軍隊又打了過來。聽說，被抓的楚懷王一直沒有答應秦王的要求，秦王很生氣，就讓軍隊再來攻打楚國。大戰一場接著一場。最大的那場戰爭裡，五萬楚軍戰死，十五座城被秦國搶走。
    在楚懷王被抓的第三年，楚國接到了最壞的消息——楚懷王在秦國病死了。

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王决定去秦国了。他带着马车队，从引都出发去秦国。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王決定去秦國了。他帶著馬車隊，從引都出發去秦國。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng jué dìng qù qín guó le tā dài zhe mǎ chē duì cóng yǐn dū chū fā qù qín guó
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu decided to go to Qin. He set off from Yindu to Qin, leading a convoy of carriages.

sentences.simplified: 但是车队刚刚开进秦国的土地，引都就失去了楚怀王的消息。
sentences.traditional: 但是車隊剛剛開進秦國的土地，引都就失去了楚懷王的消息。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì chē duì gāng gāng kāi jìn qín guó de tǔ dì yǐn dū jiù shī qù le chǔ huái wáng de xiāo xi
sentences.english: But as soon as the convoy entered Qin’s territory, Yindu lost contact with King Huai of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 等了几天，引都收到了坏消息。
sentences.traditional: 等了幾天，引都收到了壞消息。
sentences.pinyin: děng le jǐ tiān yǐn dū shōu dào le huài xiāo xi
sentences.english: After a few days, Yindu received bad news.

sentences.simplified: 原来楚怀王一到秦国，就被秦王抓走了。
sentences.traditional: 原來楚懷王一到秦國，就被秦王抓走了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái chǔ huái wáng yí dào qín guó jiù bèi qín wáng zhuā zǒu le
sentences.english: It turned out that as soon as King Huai of Chu arrived in Qin, he had been seized by the King of Qin.

sentences.simplified: 秦王把楚怀王关了起来，他要楚怀王把楚国的土地送给秦国。
sentences.traditional: 秦王把楚懷王關了起來，他要楚懷王把楚國的土地送給秦國。
sentences.pinyin: qín wáng bǎ chǔ huái wáng guān le qǐ lái tā yào chǔ huái wáng bǎ chǔ guó de tǔ dì sòng gěi qín guó
sentences.english: The King of Qin imprisoned King Huai of Chu and demanded that he hand over Chu’s land to Qin.

sentences.simplified: 如果楚怀王不答应，秦王就不放他离开。
sentences.traditional: 如果楚懷王不答應，秦王就不放他離開。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ chǔ huái wáng bù dā ying qín wáng jiù bú fàng tā lí kāi
sentences.english: If King Huai of Chu refused, the King of Qin would not let him leave.

sentences.simplified: 国家的王被人抓了，
sentences.traditional: 國家的王被人抓了，
sentences.pinyin: guó jiā de wáng bèi rén zhuā le
sentences.english: The king of the country had been captured.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王的小儿子子兰和引都的官员、贵族们害怕极了。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王的小兒子子蘭和引都的官員、貴族們害怕極了。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng de xiǎo ér zi zǐ lán hé yǐn dū de guān yuán guì zú men hài pà jí le
sentences.english: King Huai’s youngest son, Zilan, along with the officials and nobles of Yindu, were terrified.

sentences.simplified: 他们马上去齐国，把在那儿做人质的楚国太子接了回来。
sentences.traditional: 他們馬上去齊國，把在那兒做人質的楚國太子接了回來。
sentences.pinyin: tā men mǎ shàng qù qí guó bǎ zài nà'r zuò rén zhì de chǔ guó tài zǐ jiē le huí lai
sentences.english: They immediately went to Qi and brought back the crown prince of Chu, who was held there as a hostage.

sentences.simplified: 太子回到楚国，马上做了楚国的新王。
sentences.traditional: 太子回到楚國，馬上做了楚國的新王。
sentences.pinyin: tài zǐ huí dào chǔ guó mǎ shàng zuò le chǔ guó de xīn wáng
sentences.english: The crown prince returned to Chu and immediately became the new King of Chu.

sentences.simplified: 他们放弃了楚怀王！他们选了一个新王！
sentences.traditional: 他們放棄了楚懷王！他們選了一個新王！
sentences.pinyin: tā men fàng qì le chǔ huái wáng tā men xuǎn le yí ge xīn wáng
sentences.english: They had abandoned King Huai of Chu! They had chosen a new king!

sentences.simplified: 新王上位，想的第一件事不是把楚怀王接回来，
sentences.traditional: 新王上位，想的第一件事不是把楚懷王接回來，
sentences.pinyin: xīn wáng shàng wèi xiǎng de dì yī jiàn shì bú shì bǎ chǔ huái wáng jiē huí lai
sentences.english: When the new king took the throne, the first thing on his mind was not bringing King Huai of Chu back.

sentences.simplified: 而是怎么让国内的官员、贵族们支持自己。
sentences.traditional: 而是怎麼讓國內的官員、貴族們支持自己。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì zěn me ràng guó nèi de guān yuán guì zú men zhī chí zì jǐ
sentences.english: Instead, it was how to gain the support of the officials and nobles within the country.

sentences.simplified: 新王让他们做大官，给他们更好的生活。
sentences.traditional: 新王讓他們做大官，給他們更好的生活。
sentences.pinyin: xīn wáng ràng tā men zuò dà guān gěi tā men gèng hǎo de shēng huó
sentences.english: The new king made them high-ranking officials and gave them a better life.

sentences.simplified: 子兰做了楚国最大的官，他和另外的大官们都不想楚怀王回来。
sentences.traditional: 子蘭做了楚國最大的官，他和另外的大官們都不想楚懷王回來。
sentences.pinyin: zǐ lán zuò le chǔ guó zuì dà de guān tā hé lìng wài de dà guān men dōu bù xiǎng chǔ huái wáng huí lái
sentences.english: Zilan became the highest official in Chu, and he, along with the other high officials, did not want King Huai of Chu to return.

sentences.simplified: 他们害怕如果楚怀王回来了，楚怀王会杀了他们，因为是他们要楚怀王去秦国的。
sentences.traditional: 他們害怕如果楚懷王回來了，楚懷王會殺了他們，因為是他們要楚懷王去秦國的。
sentences.pinyin: tā men hài pà rú guǒ chǔ huái wáng huí lái le chǔ huái wáng huì shā le tā men yīn wèi shì tā men yào chǔ huái wáng qù qín guó de
sentences.english: They feared that if King Huai of Chu returned, he would kill them because they were the ones who wanted him to go to Qin.

sentences.simplified: 我既失望又着急，楚怀王被关在秦国，他们却只想着自己的好处。
sentences.traditional: 我既失望又著急，楚懷王被關在秦國，他們卻只想著自己的好處。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jì shī wàng yòu zháo jí chǔ huái wáng bèi guān zài qín guó tā men què zhǐ xiǎng zhe zì jǐ de hǎo chù
sentences.english: I was both disappointed and anxious. King Huai of Chu was imprisoned in Qin, yet they only thought about their own interests.

sentences.simplified: 我骂新王，骂子兰，骂那些要楚怀王去秦国的官员、贵族们。
sentences.traditional: 我罵新王，罵子蘭，罵那些要楚懷王去秦國的官員、貴族們。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ mà xīn wáng mà zǐ lán mà nà xiē yào chǔ huái wáng qù qín guó de guān yuán guì zú men
sentences.english: I cursed the new king, cursed Zilan, and cursed those officials and nobles who had sent King Huai of Chu to Qin.

sentences.simplified: 但是没有用，他们都不听，新王也不想听。
sentences.traditional: 但是沒有用，他們都不聽，新王也不想聽。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì méi yǒu yòng tā men dōu bù tīng xīn wáng yě bù xiǎng tīng
sentences.english: But it was useless; they wouldn’t listen, and the new king didn’t want to listen either.

sentences.simplified: 他们拿走了我的工作，让我又变成了一个无事可做的人。
sentences.traditional: 他們拿走了我的工作，讓我又變成了一個無事可做的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā men ná zǒu le wǒ de gōng zuò ràng wǒ yòu biàn chéng le yí ge wú shì kě zuò de rén
sentences.english: They took away my position, leaving me once again with nothing to do.

sentences.simplified: 秦国的军队又打了过来。
sentences.traditional: 秦國的軍隊又打了過來。
sentences.pinyin: qín guó de jūn duì yòu dǎ le guò lái
sentences.english: The Qin army attacked once again.

sentences.simplified: 听说，被抓的楚怀王一直没有答应秦王的要求，
sentences.traditional: 聽說，被抓的楚懷王一直沒有答應秦王的要求，
sentences.pinyin: tīng shuō bèi zhuā de chǔ huái wáng yì zhí méi yǒu dā ying qín wáng de yāo qiú
sentences.english: It was said that the captured King Huai of Chu never agreed to the King of Qin’s demands.

sentences.simplified: 秦王很生气，就让军队再来攻打楚国。大战一场接着一场。
sentences.traditional: 秦王很生氣，就讓軍隊再來攻打楚國。大戰一場接著一場。
sentences.pinyin: qín wáng hěn shēng qì jiù ràng jūn duì zài lái gōng dǎ chǔ guó dà zhàn yì cháng jiē zhe yì cháng
sentences.english: The King of Qin was enraged and sent his army to attack Chu once more. One great battle followed another.

sentences.simplified: 最大的那场战争里，五万楚军战死，十五座城被秦国抢走。
sentences.traditional: 最大的那場戰爭裡，五萬楚軍戰死，十五座城被秦國搶走。
sentences.pinyin: zuì dà de nà cháng zhàn zhēng lǐ wǔ wàn chǔ jūn zhàn sǐ shí wǔ zuò chéng bèi qín guó qiǎng zǒu
sentences.english: In the largest battle, fifty thousand Chu soldiers died, and fifteen cities were seized by Qin.

sentences.simplified: 在楚怀王被抓的第三年，楚国接到了最坏的消息——楚怀王在秦国病死了。
sentences.traditional: 在楚懷王被抓的第三年，楚國接到了最壞的消息——楚懷王在秦國病死了。
sentences.pinyin: zài chǔ huái wáng bèi zhuā de dì sān nián chǔ guó jiē dào le zuì huài de xiāo xi chǔ huái wáng zài qín guó bìng sǐ le
sentences.english: In the third year of King Huai’s captivity, Chu received the worst news—King Huai had died of illness in Qin.

sentence_translations: Chapter 15: The New King of Chu Ascends the Throne
King Huai of Chu decided to go to Qin. He set off from Yindu to Qin, leading a convoy of carriages.
But as soon as the convoy entered Qin’s territory, Yindu lost contact with King Huai of Chu.
After a few days, Yindu received bad news.
It turned out that as soon as King Huai of Chu arrived in Qin, he had been seized by the King of Qin.
The King of Qin imprisoned King Huai of Chu and demanded that he hand over Chu’s land to Qin.
If King Huai of Chu refused, the King of Qin would not let him leave.
The king of the country had been captured.
King Huai’s youngest son, Zilan, along with the officials and nobles of Yindu, were terrified.
They immediately went to Qi and brought back the crown prince of Chu, who was held there as a hostage.
The crown prince returned to Chu and immediately became the new King of Chu.
They had abandoned King Huai of Chu! They had chosen a new king!
When the new king took the throne, the first thing on his mind was not bringing King Huai of Chu back.
Instead, it was how to gain the support of the officials and nobles within the country.
The new king made them high-ranking officials and gave them a better life.
Zilan became the highest official in Chu, and he, along with the other high officials, did not want King Huai of Chu to return.
They feared that if King Huai of Chu returned, he would kill them because they were the ones who wanted him to go to Qin.
I was both disappointed and anxious. King Huai of Chu was imprisoned in Qin, yet they only thought about their own interests.
I cursed the new king, cursed Zilan, and cursed those officials and nobles who had sent King Huai of Chu to Qin.
But it was useless; they wouldn’t listen, and the new king didn’t want to listen either.
They took away my position, leaving me once again with nothing to do.
The Qin army attacked once again.
It was said that the captured King Huai of Chu never agreed to the King of Qin’s demands.
The King of Qin was enraged and sent his army to attack Chu once more. One great battle followed another.
In the largest battle, fifty thousand Chu soldiers died, and fifteen cities were seized by Qin.
In the third year of King Huai’s captivity, Chu received the worst news—King Huai had died of illness in Qin.
